Title: Predict micro-pKa of organic molecules
Description: Counts, across 22 bins, how many atoms in a molecule carry an acidic or basic micro-pKa near each integer from 0 to 10, giving a profile of ionisable sites rather than a single value. QupKake, from Abarbanel and Hutchison, first picks candidate reaction sites with a graph neural network, then predicts each site's pKa from GFN2-xTB semi-empirical quantum chemistry features, with transfer learning onto 5,637 compounds carrying measured micro-pKa values. Root-mean-square errors of 0.5 to 0.8 pKa units were reported on five external test sets.
Interpretation: Counts of atoms with acidic or basic micro-pKa values falling in each integer bin from 0 to 10.
